# Keeping pace under a bounded census / 有界普查之下的同步

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`bounded-census-keeps-pace` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](bounded-census-keeps-pace.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where the list returns within some number at arbitrarily late steps, coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace; under a bound growing without end, however slowly, arising can go on without ceasing.
>
> 列表在任意晚的步回到某数以内时，开始成立与不再成立同步；界无界地增长时，不论多慢，都可以只生不灭。

## Laws / 规律

1. Where the members of which a determination holds are listed at each step, each once, from some step T on at most B at each step, and the determination is decided at each step, members coming to hold at arbitrarily late steps need members ceasing to hold at arbitrarily late steps.<br>一个规定每步的成立者被不重复地列出、从某步 T 起每步至多 B 个，且每步可判定时，在任意晚的步有成员开始成立，就在任意晚的步有成员不再成立。 (`Becoming.Listed`, `Becoming.Listed.ceasing_of_coming`)
2. The proof goes through the census balance: with coming to be recurring, the comings from any step on accumulate past B; where the list returns within B, the list at the end is shorter than the list at the start with what came between, so by the balance something ceases between.<br>证明经过普查的平衡：开始成立复现时，从任一步起其间开始成立的累加而超过 B；列表回到 B 以内时，终点的列表短于起点的列表连同其间开始成立的，由平衡，其间有不再成立。 (`Becoming.recurring_accumulates`, `Becoming.Listed.ceasing_iff_shortfall`)
3. So the bound need not hold at every step from some step on: the list need only return within some number K at arbitrarily late steps.<br>所以界不必从某步起一直成立：列表只需在任意晚的步回到某数 K 以内。 (`Becoming.Listed.ceasing_of_returning`)
4. With the census law (ceasing-needs-arising), the two recur together where the list is bounded from some step on: coming to be recurs exactly when ceasing to be does.<br>与普查定律（ceasing-needs-arising）合起来，从某步起有界时两者同步：开始成立复现恰当不再成立复现。 (`Becoming.Listed.coming_iff_ceasing`)
5. Read of activity: under a census with at most B formations active at each step from some step on, arising recurs exactly when ceasing recurs.<br>读于活动：在从某步起每步至多 B 个形成活跃的普查之下，生起复现恰当止息复现。 (`Becoming.Web.Census`, `Becoming.Web.ceasing_of_arising`, `Becoming.Web.unceasing_iff_bounded`)
6. Read of worlds: in a world whose relata active at each step are listed, at most B of them, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does.<br>读于世界：每步至多 B 个关系项活跃且被列出的世界中，生起复现恰当止息复现。 (`Becoming.World.CountedWithin`, `Becoming.World.CountedWithin.arising_iff_ceasing`)
7. Every census of a finite world is bounded, with no decidability, and where activity is decided one exists, so the law of finite worlds, World.arising_iff_ceasing, is a case.<br>有限世界的每个普查都有界，不需要可判定性；活动可判定时普查存在，所以有限世界的规律 World.arising_iff_ceasing 是其情形。 (`Becoming.World.Finite`, `Becoming.World.Finite.census_bounded`, `Becoming.World.Finite.countedWithin`, `Becoming.World.arising_iff_ceasing`, `Becoming.World.Finite.arising_iff_ceasing`)
8. In procession, where relatum x is active at step x alone, one relatum is active at each step and arising and ceasing both recur, while the relata are not finitely many, so the law reaches beyond finite worlds; accretion has a census without a bound, and arising recurs there while ceasing does not.<br>procession（关系项 x 只在第 x 步活跃）每步一个活跃，生起与止息都复现，关系项却不是有限多个，所以这一规律越出有限世界；accretion 有普查而无界，生起复现而止息不复现。 (`Becoming.World.procession`, `Becoming.World.procession_world`, `Becoming.World.accretion`, `Becoming.World.accretion_unbounded`)
9. The bound may vary with the steps: where at most B t relata are active at each step t, listed (a constant bound being the case), and B returns within some number at arbitrarily late steps, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does.<br>界可以随步变化：每步 t 至多 B t 个关系项活跃且被列出（常数界是其情形），B 在任意晚的步回到某数以内时，生起复现恰当止息复现。 (`Becoming.World.CountedBy`, `Becoming.World.CountedBy.arising_iff_ceasing`)
10. A bound growing without end, however slowly, does not keep the two together: for any non-decreasing, unbounded B, in slow B the relata below B t are active at step t, with a census counted by B; relatum B t arises across each step at which B grows, and nothing ceases; so under logarithmic growth, for instance, arising can still go on without ceasing.<br>界无界地增长时，不论多慢，都不使两者同步：对任何不减而无界的 B，slow B 中第 t 步活跃的是 B t 以下的关系项，有普查且被 B 计数，B 增长的每一步上关系项 B t 生起，没有关系项止息；所以例如对数增长时，仍可能只生不灭。 (`Becoming.World.slow`, `Becoming.World.slow_world`)
11. Where the list grows without end, ceasing to be recurs where, from each step, the comings over some stretch outnumber the bound at its end; this is sufficient, not necessary, and in slow the comings never outnumber the bound; the exact criterion is the shortfall of census-balance.<br>列表无界地增长时，若从每一步起某段步上开始成立的多于该段终点的界，不再成立就复现；这是充分条件，不是必要条件，slow 中开始成立的从不多于界；精确的判据是缺额（census-balance）。 (`Becoming.Listed.ceasing_of_outpacing`, `Becoming.Listed.ceasing_iff_shortfall`)
12. Read of standing: where from some step on at most B conditions stand at each step, listed, coming to stand recurs exactly when ceasing to stand does. Read of dependence: where the dependences of each step are listed, at most B from some step on, forming recurs exactly when dissolving does.<br>读于水平：所立者的普查从某步起每步至多 B 个时，开始作为条件而在复现恰当不再作为条件而在复现。读于依存：每步的依存被列出且从某步起至多 B 个时，形成复现恰当消解复现。 (`Becoming.Web.StandingCensus`, `Becoming.Web.StandingCensus.coming_iff_ceasing`, `Becoming.Web.DependenceCensus`, `Becoming.Web.DependenceCensus.forming_iff_dissolving`)

## Conditions / 条件

- A listing bounded from some step on: the members holding at each step are listed, each once, with every list from some step T on no longer than one bound B; there may be infinitely many members in all.<br>从某步起有界的列出：每步成立者被不重复地列出，从某步 T 起列表的长度都不超过同一个 B；成员总共可以无限多。
- The world premise CountedWithin asks the bound at every step, the case T = 0. The more general form asks only that the list return within some number K at arbitrarily late steps (ceasing_of_returning, CountedBy.arising_iff_ceasing).<br>世界上的前提 CountedWithin 要求每步都有界，是 T = 0 的情形。更一般的形式只要求列表在任意晚的步回到某数 K 以内（ceasing_of_returning、CountedBy.arising_iff_ceasing）。
- Decidability: read of activity this is decided activity, read of standing it holds automatically; it is a logical commitment of the representation and classically always holds.<br>可判定：读于活动是活动可判定，读于水平自动成立；这是表示的逻辑承诺，经典地总是成立。
- procession_world, accretion_unbounded and Finite.countedWithin are statements about particular worlds or about finite worlds; Finite.countedWithin needs decided activity to build a census; Finite.census_bounded does not.<br>procession_world、accretion_unbounded 与 Finite.countedWithin 分别是关于具体世界或有限世界的陈述；Finite.countedWithin 要求活动可判定，以构造普查；Finite.census_bounded 不需要。
- slow_world asks the bound to be non-decreasing and unbounded and is a statement about one particular world; ceasing_of_outpacing asks every list to be no longer than the bound and, from each step, the comings over some stretch to outnumber the bound at its end.<br>slow_world 要求界不减而无界，是关于一个具体世界的陈述；ceasing_of_outpacing 要求每个列表不长于界，且从每一步起某段步上开始成立的多于该段终点的界。

## Does not show / 未表明

- The bound must return within one number at arbitrarily late steps; the law fails where the bound grows without end, however slowly (accretion, slow).<br>界须在任意晚的步回到同一个数以内；界无界地增长时不成立，不论多慢（accretion、slow）。 Witness: `Becoming.World.slow_world`.
- That a non-decreasing bound either stays within some number or grows without end is classical; the pure core states the two sides separately.<br>不减的界或停在某数以内、或无界地增长，这一二分是经典的；纯净核心分别陈述两侧。
- For a bound that is not monotone and eventually exceeds every number no corresponding world is given (its construction needs data from existence).<br>不单调而最终超过每个数的界，没有给出对应的世界（构造需要从存在得到数据）。
- The law is a count, not a mechanism: it says neither which member comes to be or ceases nor that the two are causally linked.<br>本规律是计数，不是机制：不说哪个成员开始或不再成立，也不说两者有因果关联。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** accretion: a census without a bound, arising recurring and ceasing not, so the bound is needed; procession: bounded but not finite, so finiteness is not needed.<br>accretion：有普查而无界，生起复现而止息不复现，所以界不可少；procession：有界而非有限，所以有限不是必需的。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)
- **Counterexample / 反例:** slow: for any non-decreasing, unbounded bound B, a census counted by B, arising recurring and nothing ever ceasing, so no bound growing without end, however slowly, keeps the two together.<br>slow：对任何不减而无界的界 B，有普查且被 B 计数，生起复现而从不止息，所以无界的界不论增长多慢都不使两者同步。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. 不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. 不含伦理谓词，不评价生起或消失。 · Stated for discrete steps. 按离散步骤陈述。 · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. 使用所述判定的可判定性，这是写成假设的逻辑承诺。 · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026; readings remain Ren's. 名称依 Ren 2026年10月10日的命名标准；读法由 Ren 决定。

### Correspondence / 对应

The law of a finite family (coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace: coming_recurs_iff, Web.unceasing_iff) needs one fixed finite family holding every member; here only the list at each step needs a bound, and the members may be infinitely many in all. So what the law of finite worlds needs (space-and-its-parts: in a finite world whose activity is decided arising recurring and ceasing recurring are one part) is a bound on the count, not finiteness. With the census law, the relation of arising and ceasing falls into three tiers by counting: with the active at each step finite and returning within some number at arbitrarily late steps, the two recur together; finite at each step and eventually beyond every number, ceasing needs arising and not conversely, however slowly the count grows (accretion, slow); no longer finite at each step, ceasing can recur alone (attrition has no census). The author's reading (an AI argument): in an unfolding whose active members never exceed a bound, lasting arising and lasting ceasing are two sides of one lasting change, as in a finite world, without the members being finitely many in all; renewed generations can be endless while those present together are bounded; nor need the bound always hold: those present together need only keep returning within some number, and growing without end, however slowly, they need not keep pace. This is a reading of activity and standing, arising and ceasing being names Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names); whether it is the proposal's generative and degenerative is Ren's to choose (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap; if non-overlap is taken, this reading is not what is meant, the AI's inference).<br>有限家族的定律（coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace：coming_recurs_iff、Web.unceasing_iff）要求一个固定的有限家族包含所有成员；这里只要求每步的列表有界，成员总共可以无限多。所以有限世界的规律（space-and-its-parts：活动可判定的有限世界中生起复现与止息复现是同一部分）所需要的是计数的界，不是有限。与普查定律合起来，生起与止息的关系按计数分为三层：每步的活跃者有限、且在任意晚的步回到某数以内时，两者同步；每步有限而最终超过每个数时，止息需要生起，反之不然，不论计数增长多慢（accretion、slow）；每步不再有限时，止息可以独自不息（attrition 没有普查）。作者的读法（AI 论证）：在活跃者不超过一个界的展开中，持续的生起与持续的止息是同一个持续变化的两面，正如有限世界中那样，但不需要成员总共有限；更新的世代可以无穷，只要同时在场的有界；界也不必一直成立：同时在场的只需不断回到某个数以内；无界地增长时，不论多慢，就不必同步。这是活动与水平的读法，英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）；它是否为 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”由 Ren 选择（Ren 写道“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，以“吧”预设二者不重叠；若取不重叠，这一读法就不是其所指，这是 AI 的推论）。
